api_changes.detail: The November 2 migration guide shows image generation as POST https://api.x.ai/v1/images/generations with an OpenAI client base_url of https://api.x.ai/v1. This sample only changes the model field.

code_change.before:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.x.ai/v1")
response = client.images.generate(
    model="grok-imagine-image-pro",
    prompt="A lighthouse",
)
code_change.after:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.x.ai/v1")
response = client.images.generate(
    model="grok-imagine-image-quality",
    prompt="A lighthouse",
)
